name: Omen of Chaotic Rarity
description:
While this item is active in your inventory your next
Chaos Orb will replace all Modifiers on a Waystone
with Modifiers that do not grant Item Rarity
directions: Right click this item in your inventory to set it to be active. This item is consumed when triggered.
consoleDirections: Press Xin your inventory to set it to be active. This item is consumed when triggered.
